text: You did your fucking webinar, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick.

text: Two hours. Twelve people stayed.
style: Deadpan and unimpressed, a small pause between the two sentences.

text: Your mom left before the pitch.
style: Mock-sympathetic, like whispering juicy gossip.

text: Half of them? Camera off. Eating cereal.
style: Dry and comedic, short crunchy beats.

text: Then the replay goes out. And your DMs go... "price?"
style: Building up, then a whiny, high-pitched mocking imitation on 'price?'.

text: You send the price. Ghosted.
style: Flat, then a dramatic little beat before 'Ghosted.'

text: Another one makes you explain the whole program... then: "I'll think about it."
style: Storytelling and getting annoyed, then a limp, mocking imitation on 'I'll think about it.'

text: Never heard from him again.
style: Deadpan, with a tiny dramatic pause.

text: The rest want free coaching. In your DMs. At one a.m.
style: Exasperated, an eye-roll in the voice, escalating.

text: And the six calls you booked? Zero clients.
style: Disbelief, then flat on 'Zero clients.'

text: That's not a funnel. That's a free consulting hotline.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and dramatic.

text: Plug me into ManyChat.
style: Cool and confident, a swagger switch.

text: I read your sales page. About two minutes later, I know your offer. I talk like you. Not like a bot.
style: Fast, confident and rhythmic, like listing flexes.

text: One question at a time. I wait till they're done typing.
style: Calm and smooth, a little smug.

text: Tire-kickers get the replay. The serious ones get your calendar.
style: Punchy, like a bouncer at a club door.

text: They ghost? I follow up. Three times, max. Classy.
style: Playful and smug, a little wink on 'Classy.'

text: And I book the call. With a summary. In your calendar.
style: Proud and rhythmic.

text: If it gets spicy, I hand it to you.
style: Casual and reassuring, a grin in the voice.

text: You? Close the laptop. And put some pants on, you fucking animal.
style: Teasing, affectionate roast with comedic timing, a beat before 'you fucking animal'.

text: Comment SETTY. I'll slide into your DMs.
style: Smooth, smug, a little flirty sign-off.
